// `Demo.Typed` — the FPP model as SysML v2 structure.
// Generated by `fpp-to-sysml` from [ local path prefix ]/tools/fpp-to-sysml/test/top/unusedSerial.fpp (fpp [version]). Do not edit: regenerate. Port types, components
// with their ports, the topology's parts and connections — what every implementation of a component must agree
// on — and each component's external contract — commands, events, telemetry channels, parameters, ids relative
// to the base id — as items of its part def. Behaviour is not in FPP and not here. Output ports are conjugated;
// a port array of size n is n ports `name_i`.
package FppGen {
    private import ScalarValues::*;

    package Types {  // the FPP types the ports and the contracts use, opaque here (their layout is FPP's)
        attribute def Sample;  // FPP type Sample, opaque here
        attribute def Readings;  // FPP type Readings, opaque here
    }

    package Contract {  // what the dictionary publishes about a component; ids are relative to the instance's base id
        attribute def SizedString :> String { attribute size : Natural; }  // FPP `string[size]`
        item def Command { attribute opcode : Natural; }
        item def Event { attribute id : Natural; attribute severity : String; attribute format : String; attribute throttle : Natural[0..1]; }
        item def Channel { attribute id : Natural; attribute update : String; }
        item def Parameter { attribute id : Natural; attribute setOpcode : Natural; attribute saveOpcode : Natural; }
    }

    port def Demo_Data {
        inout attribute sample : Types::Sample;
        in attribute label : String;
    }

    port def Demo_Query {
        in attribute readings : Types::Readings;
        out attribute result : Integer;
    }

    part def Demo_Probe {  // passive component Demo.Probe
        port dataOut : ~Demo_Data;  // output
    }

    part def Demo_Sink {  // passive component Demo.Sink
        port dataIn : Demo_Data;  // sync input
        port queryOut : ~Demo_Query;  // output
    }

    part def Demo_Typed {
        part probe : Demo_Probe;  // Demo.probe, base id 1792
        part sinkA : Demo_Sink;  // Demo.sinkA, base id 2048

        connect probe.dataOut to sinkA.dataIn;  // Data
    }
}
